meta.title: Sidebar menu
meta.description: Control the left sidebar from Settings → "Sidebar menu". Show or fold away the built-in panels (Plugins, Plugin market, Tasks, and any other panel you installed) and keep your own shortcut entries in the sidebar's More menu, which you can reorder by dragging. Folding a panel only moves it into More: nothing is deleted, and the Plugins panel always stays in the sidebar. Your saved layout is re-applied automatically each time the app starts. Shortcut entries and panel choices are stored in this app and survive a restart.
